2014_spells.draconic-fear.description: You project a fearsome draconic visage. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
2014_spells.draconic-fear.effectSummary: Make a target frightened until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.draconic-fear.fullDescriptio: Using 1 action, a frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or become frightened of you for 1 minute; You project a fearsome draconic visage. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
